fusions.name: Lit Strand
fusions.desc: A whip of burning strands that deals 4 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 10% for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flash Singe
fusions.desc: Flings out a fan of flaring strands that deals 26 damage to everything within 4 tiles ahead of you and sets each [Burning] for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Snaring Strands
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile web of smouldering strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. Anything caught moves 25% slower for 2 seconds and is set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Weave
fusions.desc: Your fire damage cannot be resisted.
